correctness.rationale: The independent exponential first-arrival clocks generate exact weighted Bernoulli indicators. The proof evaluates F_infinity(A)=log(A)+2gamma+O(1/A), controls the finite-N omission by A/N+O(A/N^2+(A/N)^2), obtains the exact-root bias expansion, proves V_N(A)=(2A)^(-1)+o(1/A) and a Lindeberg CLT for the weighted indicators, then inverts the monotone CDF at the exact mean root. The N^(2/3) boundary follows from comparing the positive relative root bias A_N/N with stochastic scale A_N^(-1/2). Numerical checker passes 34 finite tests, not claimed to prove the limiting laws.

The exact Gaussian variance and exact-root centering quantify nontrivial distributional variability.
